description: Shared behavioral fixtures for the request.body.<METHOD>.schema JSON Schema 2020-12 profile (#845). test/body-schema-profile.test.ts runs every accepted case through the Node validator and through the Cloudflare build's standalone validators, and every refused case through load-time admission.

issues.message: must not match the schema declared in not
must match exactly one declared alternative
must match at least one declared alternative
does not match the declared pattern
has a property name the schema does not allow

refused.name: unsupported keyword
refused.message: Body schema /properties/a/unevaluatedProperties: keyword "unevaluatedProperties" is not in the supported JSON Schema 2020-12 profile

refused.name: dynamic ref
refused.message: Body schema /properties/a/$dynamicRef: keyword "$dynamicRef" is not in the supported JSON Schema 2020-12 profile (dynamic references are not supported)

refused.name: remote ref
refused.message: Body schema /properties/a/$ref: $ref must be a local #/$defs/<name> reference; remote, $id-relative and JSON-pointer references into other keywords are not resolved or fetched

refused.name: schema id
refused.message: Body schema /$id: keyword "$id" is not in the supported JSON Schema 2020-12 profile (schema identifiers are not resolved; use a local #/$defs reference)

refused.name: other dialect
refused.message: Body schema /$schema: only https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema is supported

refused.name: undeclared def
refused.message: Body schema /properties/a/$ref: $ref names a $defs entry that is not declared

refused.name: recursive ref
refused.message: Body schema /$defs/node/properties/child/$ref: recursive $ref (a cycle through $defs) is not supported

refused.name: regex DoS pattern
refused.message: Body schema /properties/a/pattern: Pattern cannot repeat a group without a bound

refused.name: regex DoS patternProperties
refused.message: Body schema /patternProperties/^(a|aa)*$: Pattern cannot repeat a group without a bound

refused.name: patternProperties without a name bound
refused.message: Body schema /patternProperties: patternProperties requires propertyNames with maxLength of at most 128 on the same schema

refused.name: unbounded uniqueItems
refused.message: Body schema /uniqueItems: uniqueItems requires maxItems of at most 64 on the same schema

refused.name: unknown format
refused.message: Body schema /format: unsupported format (supported: uuid, date, time, date-time, email, uri, hostname, ipv4, ipv6)

refused.name: properties matched by patternProperties
refused.message: Body schema /properties/x-id: is also matched by /patternProperties/^x-, so both schemas would apply (Ajv strict mode refuses this); narrow the pattern or keep the property's rules in one place

refused.name: overlap inside $defs, pointer escaped
refused.message: Body schema /$defs/o/properties/x~1a: is also matched by /$defs/o/patternProperties/^x, so both schemas would apply (Ajv strict mode refuses this); narrow the pattern or keep the property's rules in one place

refused.name: required property forbidden by additionalProperties false
refused.message: Body schema /required/1: names a property that additionalProperties: false forbids (it is not in properties and matches no patternProperties pattern), so no object can satisfy this schema; declare it in properties

refused.name: string keyword on a number
refused.message: Body schema /properties/n/minLength: minLength applies only to string values, but this schema's type is number, so it would never run; drop it or add the type

refused.name: object keyword on a string
refused.message: Body schema /required: required applies only to object values, but this schema's type is string, null, so it would never run; drop it or add the type

refused.name: const of another type, value not echoed
refused.message: Body schema /properties/pin/const: the value is not of this schema's type (integer), so nothing can match it

refused.name: enum value of another type
refused.message: Body schema /enum/1: the value is not of this schema's type (integer), so it can never match; drop it or add the type

refused.name: minItems beyond a closed tuple
refused.message: Body schema /minItems: requires more than the 1 items prefixItems allows while items is false, so no array can satisfy this schema; declare more prefixItems or drop items: false
